title: WorkPulse attendance.late v1
description: A check-in was judged late against the resolved shift (exclusive `start + grace` boundary, location timezone). Emitted alongside `attendance.checked_in`, never instead of it.

attendance_id.description: The attendance record judged late (UUIDv7 string).

employee_id.description: Employee the record belongs to (UUIDv7 string).

workday.description: Calendar date the lateness was judged on (the record's workday).

shift_id.description: Shift the lateness was judged against (UUIDv7 string). Never null — no shift means never late.

minutes_late.description: Whole minutes past `shift.start_time + grace_minutes` (floor) — `0` can accompany a late flag inside the first minute.
